items.name: Lunar occultation of Regulus
items.title: 02 Mar 2026 (5 hours away): Lunar occultation of Regulus
items.summary: The Moon will pass in front of Regulus (Alpha Leonis), creating a lunar occultation visible from countries and territories including Russia, China, Mongolia and Japan amongst others.
